title: Writing / Style / Lists
slide_intent: Keep parallel list items grammatically parallel so a reader can scan them as one coherent group.
strategic_value: Two contrasting list formats can help Duolingo avoid uneven rhythm within otherwise simple explanatory copy.
demonstration: A fruit list of lowercase fragments is followed by a list of complete sentences about learning motivations.
practical_value: Decide whether the list uses fragments or sentences, then apply that form to every item.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Lists heading and consistency requirement at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Show the fragment-list instruction and example above the complete-sentence instruction and example at right.

reference_purposes.Application: Two complete lists demonstrate the different treatments of fragments and sentences.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Lead into a list with a colon; fragments have no capitalization or terminal punctuation, complete sentences have both, and items within a list must use the same form.

ingredient.name: List construction
ingredient.role: Make parallel items easy to scan.
ingredient.application: Use a colon before lists; format all items as either unpunctuated lowercase fragments or capitalized, punctuated sentences.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
